name: Contrôleur des aqueducs
description: Long-limbed middle-aged adult with dark slate and ochre mottled skin, high flat narrow forehead ridge, long mandible tusks, very long dreadlocks collected in a low braided tail. Holds a compact bronze sighting level on a folded short hand support at waist height, other hand steadies a flat disk water-flow sensor on belt. Body three-quarter right, head attentive, calm walking-idle weight shift.
